title: Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO Details
intro:
Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO is a book build issue of ₹42.10 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 77.96 lakh shares of ₹42.10 crore.

Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO opens for subscription on Oct 13, 2026 and closes on Oct 15, 2026. The allotment for the Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 16, 2026. Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 21, 2026.

Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO is a book build issue of ₹42.10 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 77.96 lakh shares of ₹42.10 crore.

Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO opens for subscription on Oct 13, 2026 and closes on Oct 15, 2026. The allotment for the Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 16, 2026. Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 21, 2026.

Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO is set issue price band at ₹51 to ₹54 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,16,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,24,000.

GetFive Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO comprises a total issue size of 77,96,000 shares. The net offer to the public is 74,06,000 shares, after excluding 3,90,000 shares allotted on a firm basis. Of the Net offer 36,94,000 (49.88%) are allocated to QIB , 11,16,000 (15.07%) allocated to NII 25,96,000 (35.05%) allocated to RII .

Investors can bid for a minimum of 4,000 shares and in multiples of 2,000 shares thereof.

Incorporated in February 2009, Vaibhav Vyapaar Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) providing unsecured personal loans to salaried and self-employed individuals through its fully digital lending platform. The Company provides personal loans under the “LoanFront” brand through its mobile application, which supports loan origination, customer verification, due diligence, underwriting, documentation, disbursal and repayment. It provides loans through both direct lending and co-lending arrangements with other NBFCs and also generates revenue by providing application and technology services to other NBFCs. Its lending operations primarily cater to salaried and self-employed borrowers, including first-time borrowers and lower-income salaried professionals across urban and semi-urban regions of India.

The Company follows a technology-enabled lending model supported by digital verification, credit assessment, credit decisioning and risk evaluation tools. It has been operating its digital lending business through the LoanFront platform for the last six years. The Company was acquired by CapFront Technologies Private Limited in October 2019, following which it continued to expand its digital lending operations. As of July 31, 2026, the Company had Assets Under Management (AUM) of ₹812.41 crore, net worth of ₹471.96 crore and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80.

As of July 31, 2026, the Company had 56 employees, including 17 employees in technology, 11 in operations and 11 in risk functions. Its operations are supported by an experienced management team with expertise in digital lending and financial services.

Vaibhav Vyapaar Ltd.'s revenue increased by 48% and profit after tax (PAT) rose by 33% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025.

faqs.question: How to apply in Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO will be done on Friday, October 16, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Oct 19, 2026 . Check the Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO allotment status .
